items.headline: James Jones rushes for 178 yards and a touchdown as New Mexico State beats Sam Houston 30-24
items.description: — James Jones rushed for 178 yards and a touchdown, Adam Damante threw for two scores and New Mexico State beat Sam Houston 30-24 on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Robert Czeremcha makes career-high 5 field goals as FIU beats New Mexico State 22-3
